# go-modern-slices-clip

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Clip to remove unused capacity.

## Details

slices.Clip limits a slice's capacity to its length.
Use it to stop retaining excess backing-array capacity or to prevent later appends from reusing hidden capacity.

## Examples

### Before

```go
s = s[:len(s):len(s)]
```

### After

```go
s = slices.Clip(s)
```
